overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance shows clear audience preference for relationship dynamics and family bond themes, particularly husband-wife and romantic complexities (e.g., 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' with 1766 views and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' with 1674 views). General poetry/shayari performs significantly lower compared to grounded relationship realities.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like my5mP9feI7s ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?') and or5gtaBpRVY ('पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए') garnered the highest views (1,766 and 1,674) and engagement on the channel.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more narrative-driven shorts focusing on everyday marital misunderstandings, emotional distance, and unspoken affection.

winning_patterns.evidence: NO5fdHLxFL4 ('Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota') and rl_ycNbXZ_g ('रिश्ते खत्म नहीं होते, बात बंद हो जाती है') performed well above the channel average.
winning_patterns.action: Focus on the psychological micro-moments in relationships where ego or silence ruins connections.

weak_patterns.evidence: YdWh4cDOE64 ('जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा') received only 14 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid purely poetic or philosophical heavy lines without an attached grounded real-life context.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic Sibling/Parent Monologues without a Twist
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like jfmMztnam_A ('बहन सिर्फ घर की रौनक होती है') stalled at 19 views.
weak_patterns.action: Introduce conflict or an unexpected emotional realization instead of standard praise-based statements.
